# M3-S7: cross-package option facts for .lgo importers (T-Sec6).
# Package a exports option positions; package b sees them as options
# (narrowing required) and sees plain pointers as non-nil.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

cd lgo
logos build ./...
logos build -o $WORK/bin/factsnil$GOEXE ./cmd
exec $WORK/bin/factsnil$GOEXE
stdout '^facts ok: gadget$'
cd ..

# Direct use of an option without narrowing fails.
cd neg
! logos build ./...
stderr 'nil_deref_unproven'
stderr 'nonnil_uninitialized'
cd ..

-- lgo/go.mod --
module example.com/factsnil

go 1.27

-- lgo/a/a.lgo --
package a

type User struct {
	Name string
}

type T struct {
	X int
}

func F() *User? {
	return &User{Name: "alice"}
}

type Box struct {
	P *T?
}

func (b *Box) Get() *T? {
	return b.P
}

func G(u *User) string {
	return u.Name
}

func H() []int? {
	return nil
}

-- lgo/b/b.lgo --
package b

import "example.com/factsnil/a"

func CallG(u *a.User) string {
	return a.G(u)
}

-- lgo/cmd/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/factsnil/a"
	"example.com/factsnil/b"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println("facts ok: " + b.CallG(&a.User{Name: "gadget"}))
}

-- neg/go.mod --
module example.com/factsneg

go 1.27

require example.com/factsnil v0.0.0

replace example.com/factsnil => ../lgo

-- neg/main.lgo --
package main

import "example.com/factsnil/a"

var p *a.User

func main() {
	println(a.F().Name)
	println(p.Name)
}
